entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Test Failure] NoClientCert_DefaultValue_ResumeSucceeds fails to resume TLS 1.3 #138096
  • FileSystemWatcher on macOS: SIGSEGV (pc = 0) in FSEvents `implementation_callback_rpc` on the ".NET File Watcher" thread #138095
  • JIT: redundant bounds check in span.Slice(c, span.Length - 2 * c) when span.Length >= 2 * c #138092
    12.0.0
  • JsonObject's ICollection<KeyValuePair<string, JsonNode?>>.Remove ignores the value #138090
  • JsonNode.GetPath() and JsonException.Path produce `$..x` / `$.a.` for empty property names #138089
  • Process.Run/RunAsync(silent: true) still creates a console window when the parent is a GUI app #138088

Closed

  • Test failure: System.Security.Cryptography.Xml.Tests.EncryptedXmlTests.EncryptedXml_DecryptDocument_MaxCount_Default #136054
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: Runtime_134489.TestEntryPoint cannot start a thread on browser WASM #138072
  • Usage of BOLT (the LLVM post-optimizer) #93626
    Future
  • Is it possible to get an Avalonia app published into the Apple iOS App Store? #93366
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Queue RevocationResponder work items to the global thread pool queue #138097
    area-System.Net.Security, test-bug
  • Enforce RespectNullableAnnotations for non-constructor members on continuation and metadata paths #138091
    area-System.Text.Json, community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Disable HTTP functional tests on Android x64 #138079
    Servicing-approved, area-System.Net.Http, test-bug
  • Pass the custom marshaler managed type to its QCall as a pointer #138093
    arch-wasm, area-VM-coreclr
  • [cDAC] Fix riscv64/loongarch64 gaps and interpreter stack walking #137365
    community-contribution, arch-loongarch64, arch-riscv, area-Diagnostics-cdac
  • Skip multithreading JIT test on unsupported platforms #138094
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [wasm] Bump chrome for testing - linux: 158.0.8127.36, windows: 159.0.8154.13, mac: 159.0.8154.13 #138087
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-mono

Updated

  • Preserve range facts for unpromoted span lengths #136865
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [wasm] Compute string constructor thunk keys from signatures, and test interpreter transitions #138035
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • [wasm] Add browser-wasm64 support for CoreCLR (interpreter and ReadyToRun) #138027
    arch-wasm, area-ReadyToRun, os-browser
  • Emit a placeholder AuxiliaryModuleMetadata section in crossgen2 #137515
    arch-wasm, area-ReadyToRun
  • Allow CSE for address-exposed locals #136832
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Canonicalize unused field addresses and length reads #136738
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Share modular range arithmetic across comparison optimizations #136926
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Delete and inline more Win32 wrappers from PAL #137944
    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Run libraries outerloop on a bare Azure Linux 4 VM #138019
    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • Rewrite SpanHelpers.Reverse in safe code #138082
    area-System.Memory, reduce-unsafe
  • JIT: rematerialize single-use invariant locals on Wasm #138061
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: Add KnownBits analysis and use it to fold relops #137936
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [browser][CoreCLR] Collect ReadyToRun PGO with indexed schemas #137502
